title: Best Soft and Chewy Sugar Cookies

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats.
Combine the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt in a medium bowl and set aside.
Cream the butter and sugars together in a large mixer bowl on medium speed until light in color and fluffy, 2-3 minutes.
Add the egg and mix until well combined.
Add the vanilla extract and mix until well combined.
Add the dry ingredients and mix until the dough is well combined. Do not over mix. Use a rubber spatula to help form a cohesive ball.
Create 1 ½ tablespoon sized balls of cookie dough. Roll gently into a ball, then coat each in additional sugar. Set on the baking sheet.
Bake cookies for 7-8 minutes. Remove just before the edges begin to turn golden.
Allow to cool on baking sheets for 4-5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
